newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson-CSF delays decision on bylaws.
newsitem.headline: Thomson-CSF delays decision on bylaws.

text.p: French defence group Thomson-CSF said in a statement on Monday that its shareholder's meeting had decided not to make scheduled decisions on changes to its corporate bylaws pending a government decision on its future.
The shareholder's meeting did approve the 1996 accounts.
Thomson-CSF chairman Marcel Roulet said in the statement that the decision on the bylaws did not prejudice any government decision.
The previous conservative government had shortlisted Alcatel Alsthom and Lagardere Groupe as buyers for the state's 58 percent stake in Thomson-CSF.
It would have made a decision before the end of June, but the June 1 election victory of the Socialists has put the procedure on hold.
